title: LIVE Coverage: Sara Duterte's impeachment trial, Sept. 14
summary: Follow the trial, in context and in real time.

blocks.text: New witnesses on Taguig infrastructure projects surface – Lacson

New witnesses have approached the Office of the Ombudsman to detail the delivery of “boxes of money” tied to anomalous infrastructure projects in Taguig, Sen. Panfilo Lacson said yesterday, a day after Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano returned home from Singapore.

blocks.text: Obstruction raps eyed over Bato’s escape

The National Bureau of Investigation and the Office of the Ombudsman are investigating a possible obstruction of justice complaint over the escape of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa from the Senate, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said over the weekend.

blocks.caption: AMLC to confirm P6.7 billion bank transactions of VP, Mans?

blocks.text: AMLC to confirm P6.7 billion bank transactions of VP, Mans?

The Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) is expected to present to the Senate impeachment court today its report on the P6.7 billion in transactions linked to the bank accounts of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio under Article II of the impeachment, on unexplained wealth.

blocks.text: ‘Biased impeach vote likely for absent senator-judges’

Senator-judges who missed the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte might end up voting based solely on political persuasion or alliances, Sen. Panfilo Lacson warned yesterday, questioning how absent members can make an informed decision to convict or acquit the impeached official.
